// Self-test loader: the synthetic Harbourline data pack embedded as files, so the whole flow can run without a manual upload.
const files = [{"name": "01_EDC_minutes_Jan-Mar2027.txt", "mime": "text/plain", "b64": ""}, {"name": "02_Contractor_progress_report_Feb2027.pdf", "mime": "application/pdf", "b64": ""}, {"name": "02_Contractor_progress_report_Jan2027.pdf", "mime": "application/pdf", "b64": ""}, {"name": "02_Contractor_progress_report_Mar2027.pdf", "mime": "application/pdf", "b64": ""}, {"name": "03_Contract_deliverables_schedule.csv", "mime": "text/csv", "b64": ""}, {"name": "04_Seed_risk_register.csv", "mime": "text/csv", "b64": ""}, {"name": "05_Resident_consultation_responses.csv", "mime": "text/csv", "b64": ""}, {"name": "06_Lessons_learned_Seabreeze_Hub.txt", "mime": "text/plain", "b64": ""}, {"name": "07_Grant_milestone_tranche_schedule.txt", "mime": "text/plain", "b64": ""}];
const binary = {};
for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
  binary['sample_' + i] = await this.helpers.prepareBinaryData(Buffer.from(files[i].b64, 'base64'), files[i].name, files[i].mime);
}
